import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = len(s)
    solve = ""
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if i + 3 <= n:
            if s[i:i+3] == "dot":
                solve += "."
                i += 2
            else:
                if i + 2 <= n:
                    if s[i:i+2] == "at":
                        solve += "@"
                        i += 1
                    else:
                        solve += s[i]
                else:
                    solve += s[i]
        elif i + 2 <= n:
            if s[i:i+2] == "at":
                solve += "@"
                i += 1
            else:
                solve += s[i]
        else:
            solve += s[i]
        i += 1

    # Check function
    if solve[0] == '.':
        solve = "dot" + solve[1:]
    elif solve[0] == '@':
        solve = "at" + solve[1:]

    if solve[-1] == '.':
        solve = solve[:-1] + "dot"
    elif solve[-1] == '@':
        solve = solve[:-1] + "at"

    cont = solve.count('@')

    if cont == 1:
        sys.stdout.write(solve + "\n")
    else:
        ok = True
        for ch in solve:
            if ch == '@':
                if ok:
                    sys.stdout.write('@')
                    ok = False
                else:
                    sys.stdout.write("at")
                continue
            sys.stdout.write(ch)
        sys.stdout.write("\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
